Title: A Randomized Controlled Trial of Technology-Enhanced Behavioral Parent Training: Sustained Parent Skill Use and Child Outcomes at Follow-Up
Author: Justin Parent et al.
Comment: The post-treatment arm means and SDs are multiple-imputation descriptive statistics; the paper reports 20 imputed datasets created by group. M_diff is personalised TE-HNC minus standard HNC: 12.39 − 13.65 = −1.26; this value is also stated in the supplied pre-identified effect.
